notes.title: Kickstarter is now live for Net Knight!
notes.content:
I noticed that the MMBN fans that I've interacted with are incredibly collaborative and creative, and so I designed reward tiers of all different levels that would allow folks to express their awesome ideas! My goal is to help fans bring some of their unique creations to life, while filling the game's Net with amazing interactions. Rewards allow you to design your own dialogue, Net Knight encounters, battle cards, and outfits, all the way up to architecting your own secret boss or level. I personally can't wait to see what folks come up with, and am so excited to see the game evolve with your input!

Big thanks to the forum for providing constant encouragement, feedback, and ideas that have made the game infinitely better! And any help spreading the news is greatly appreciated!

Net Knight will be launching on Nintendo Switch, Steam (Windows, Linux, Mac), and Mobile (Android, IOS), with a planned release for next year:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/netknight/net-knight?ref=cv2qyr
